> 📘 **Note**

> **Note**
>
> Steps to enable currency conversion for an organization:
>
> 1. Enable currency conversion with CONF\_CURRENCY\_CONVERSION\_ENABLE on the Billing Configuration page.
> 2. Add the base currency and supported currencies for the org as mentioned in Create or Modify Organization Profile Information.
> 3. Add base currencies to stores as mentioned in the Setup Organization Hierarchy.
> 4. Update currency conversion ratio for the base currency and supported currencies either through the Org 5. Currency Ratio profile (Import Framework) or /v2/currency ratio API.\
>    After these steps, wait for one hour. When the server clears the cache, you can see the values.

blocks.raw: ## Stores
blocks.text: Stores

blocks.raw: This profile allows you to create multiple stores for an organization using direct file importing. You cannot modify existing stores using Data Exchange; however, you can create multiple zones at once.
blocks.text: This profile allows you to create multiple stores for an organization using direct file importing. You cannot modify existing stores using Data Exchange; however, you can create multiple zones at once.

blocks.raw:
> **Important**
>
> Every store must be mapped to a valid zone. If you do not specify a zone code for a store, the system automatically assigns the store to the default zone code 'ROOT', which is auto-created for your organization. If a store is not mapped to any zone or the mapping is incorrect, the import will fail with the error message: "Parent zone not mapped or is not correct." To avoid this, ensure that each store has a valid zone code.
>
> On the import page, you can use the configuration option 'Replace invalid zone code with → ROOT' to automatically assign the default 'ROOT' zone to any stores with missing or invalid zone codes. This helps prevent import errors and ensures all stores are properly mapped.

blocks.raw: ## Store Tills
blocks.text: Store Tills

blocks.raw: This profile allows you to add multiple TILLs for stores. You cannot modify existing TILLs using Data Import Framework. You can also make a TILL billable (1) or nonbillable (0) with the column Is Billable. This is used for accounting purposes.
blocks.text: This profile allows you to add multiple TILLs for stores. You cannot modify existing TILLs using Data Import Framework. You can also make a TILL billable (1) or nonbillable (0) with the column Is Billable. This is used for accounting purposes.

blocks.raw:
> **Important**
>
> Till usernames must be unique across all organizations within the same cluster. If you try to create a till with a username that already exists in any organization in the cluster, the import will fail with an error. Usernames from soft-deleted tills are also reserved and cannot be reused, even if they are not visible in active listings. Attempting to reuse a reserved username will result in an import error.

Usernames from soft-deleted tills are also reserved and cannot be reused, even if they are not visible in active listings. Attempting to reuse a reserved username will result in an import error.
